title: Rosemary Beach "SeaChelle" 15 St Augustine Unit 15D
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Blocks from Rosemary Center- St. Augustine Park views - Private balcony- Building elevator- 2 Complementary Bikes- Located next to St. Augustine Park and the Rosemary Beach Community Complex and Pool- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Discover a divine coastal experience at SeaChelle, a beautiful 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom Rosemary Beach condo that accommodates 5 guests. Located a few blocks from Rosemary Center, this charming property offers a heavenly home base for groups or family retreats. The famous sugar-white sands and emerald waters of 30A are only a 7-minute walk, and guests enjoy access to all of Rosemary Beach’s neighborhood pools. Imagine unhurried mornings taking in views of St. Augustine Park from the private balcony before setting off to explore the area’s quaint cobblestone streets, exceptional cuisine, and delightful shopping!Filled with natural light and carefully selected artwork, this gorgeous condo offers a comfortable coastal feel. The fully equipped kitchen features granite countertops, high-end appliances, and a breakfast bar that seats 2, making it easy to chat with loved ones while crafting a delicious dinner to share. The round beach-inspired dining table seats 4 for intimate dinner parties—or grab a deck of cards for a friendly game night! In the living space, a soft couch and 3 armchairs provide seating for catching up on the day’s adventures or enjoying a movie night together. When the fresh air beckons, amble out the French doors to the spacious covered balcony, furnished with Adirondack chairs and a bar table. The park across the street provides peaceful views, perfect for luxuriating in the Emerald Coast breeze. At bedtime, rest comfortably in the primary bedroom’s king bed and the guest bedroom’s queen bed—each is an award-winning Saatva Classic. The primary bedroom boasts a luxurious private bathroom with a soaking tub, and both bedrooms include TVs.With a quieter setting that’s still in proximity to the Cabana and Sky Pools, beach access, and all the bustling fun of Rosemary Beach, SeaChelle is the ultimate beach escape. Exploring is easy with nearby public parking, 2 provided parking tags, and 2 complimentary bikes, though there’s plenty to discover on foot! Exit the front entrance to explore St. Augustine Park or take the back entrance and discover the Butterfly Garden, fitness trail, and other popular pocket parks along a wooden boardwalk system that leads to the beach. Book today and start planning your next coastal escape!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo - Guest Bedroom: Rollaway bed stored in closetIn addition, you also have access to the these fantastic Rosemary Beach amenities:- Coquina Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm.- Sky Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 6 am to 10 pm (Adult Only Hours, 6 am-9 am & 8 pm-10 pm)- Cabana Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm. - Barbados Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm. Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
